race.comment: SIXTY GRAND (8) has the most appealing profile after winning as a well-supported favourite at Morphettville, and his earlier second at this track behind FOIX reads strongly given he was beaten only a head after being slow away and held up. FOIX (9) comes back from 2580m to a distance range that suits far better, and his perfect record at this track and trip keeps him right in the race. CABLE DANCER (2) is third-up, has an excellent record at this venue and was sound enough late at Seymour with improvement to come. NOTHINGELSEMATTERS (6) can kick up from the inside and hold on late.
